name: Transport
description: The Transport template is a reimagining of the Vehicle template focused on ferrying allies around the battlefield.

name: Enhanced Capacity
effect: The Transport gains +5 HP and +1 Speed and is at least 1 Size larger than normal, up to a maximum of Size 4. However, it cannot split its movement and must move in straight lines.

active_effects.name: Enhanced Capacity
active_effects.detail: You cannot split your movement and must move in straight lines.

name: Rapid Redeployer
effect:
If they are not Immobilized, adjacent allied characters may board the Transport as a quick action, starting a ride. Allied characters (including drones) may also deploy already riding with the Transport.
During the ride, passengers occupy the Transport's spaces and are moved with the Transport whenever it moves. A passenger's ride ends when they move away from the Transport or the Transport is destroyed. Before the ride ends, they first move into a free space of the triggering character's choice adjacent to the Transport.
The Transport can carry one Squad or characters whose combined Size is less than its own.

active_effects.name: Rapid Redeployer
active_effects.detail:
If they are not Immobilized, adjacent allied characters may board you as a quick action, starting a ride.
During the ride, passengers occupy your spaces and are moved with you whenever you move. A passenger's ride ends when they move away from you or you are destroyed. Before the ride ends, they first move into a free space of the triggering character's choice adjacent to you.
You can carry one Squad or characters whose combined Size is less than your own.

name: No Manipulators
effect: The Transport can't Interact with objects or the environment or make melee attacks other than Ram.

active_effects.name: No Manipulators
active_effects.detail: You can't Interact with objects or the environment or make melee attacks other than Ram.

name: All-Terrain
effect: The Transport climbs at normal speed and ignores difficult terrain.

active_effects.name: All-Terrain
active_effects.detail: You climb at normal speed and ignore difficult terrain.

name: Amphibious
effect: The Transport moves normally in water.

name: Airborne
effect: The Transport may treat any and all of its movement as flying.

active_effects.name: Airborne
active_effects.detail: You may treat any and all of your movement as flying.

name: Spaceborne
effect: The Transport moves normally in zero-g environments.

active_effects.name: Spaceborne
active_effects.detail: You move normally in zero-g environments.

name: Eternal Engine
effect: Whenever the Transport would become Immobilized or Stunned, it instead becomes Slowed for the same duration. This cannot be bypassed by Immunity to Slowed or the effects of Slowed.

active_effects.name: Eternal Engine
active_effects.detail: Whenever you would become Immobilized or Stunned, you instead become Slowed for the same duration. This cannot be bypassed by Immunity to Slowed or the effects of Slowed.
